newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore property stocks jump on various factors.
newsitem.headline: Singapore property stocks jump on various factors.

text.p: Singapore property shares rebounded strongly on Monday morning on a variety of factors, dealers said.
At 0301 GMT, the Stock Exchange of Singapore Property Index was up 14.67 points, or 2.11 percent, at 711.06.

Dealers said several newspaper reports could have boosted share prices. One said developers saw the property market recovering in 1998 based on higher bids at recent state tenders. Another said home loans said had picked up.
But they said a number of other factors were behind the bounce.
"I think it is a case where those who were partial to selling are now holding on to their stocks after the reports," said one institutional dealer.
"If the US Federal Reserve raised interst rates on Tuesday, property stocks here are going to have another squeeze," he
"Companies like Wing Tai have reported a good set of results and they expect to do well, and others have also had some news to lift their share prices," another institutional dealer said.
Among property gainers were City Development which rose Singapore S$0.50 to S$13.20 and Wing Tai up S$0.16 to S$4.20.
Others said bottom-fishing after last week's sell down and short-covering were contributing to firmer prices.
